summary: Frontend testing of beneficiary-detail.tsx clinical/premium flat style refonte - ALL FEATURES VERIFIED. Flat rows with label/value separated by thin lines (no nested cards), 4 health vitals always shown in 2x2 grid with '--' placeholder for missing data, 'Voir la page sante' button below vitals, full-width 'Appeler' slide button in header, centered name, NO badge pills in header, zone help popup with glass blur.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Beneficiary detail page clinical/premium flat style verified. All requirements met: (1) NO cards inside cards - flat rows with label/value separated by thin 1px lines, (2) All 4 health vitals always shown (Pouls/SpO2/Tension/Temperature) in 2x2 grid with '--' placeholder when no data (SpO2 and Tension show '--'), (3) 'Voir la page sante' button placed BELOW the 4 health vitals grid, (4) 'Appeler Josette' is full-width slide button in header (440px width), (5) Name 'Josette Zuchiatti' centered in header with 'Fiche beneficiaire' subtitle, (6) NO badge pills (age/gender/blood) in header - info moved to content sections, (7) Zone help popup has glass blur effect (backdropFilter: blur(24px)).
